item.title: Plug 0.9.1
item.description:
• Sections switch about ten times faster: Manufacturers and Browse › Plug-ins in ~0.1 s (was 1–1.4 s), Deals, New and Samples in ~0.1 s (was 0.35–0.6 s).
  • Searching Browse no longer stalls on every key: the list updates when you pause.
  • A big manufacturer's line (Native Instruments, 446 products) opens twice as fast.
  • Makers is now called Manufacturers.
